message: Independent exact-head review found a blocking Home recovery regression on PR #2842 e387b5d0b7d743abe06818e9d19910a1f73f13ee: connecting/reconnecting progress states drop presentation.title entirely, leaving only the explanatory message. Keep the meaningful state title and hide only duplicate progress decoration, then re-review. Command-authority hardening otherwise reviewed cleanly. GitHub cannot record REQUEST_CHANGES because swarm workers share the repository owner account; commit-anchored COMMENT review 4904554424 records the blocker.
